chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to Zaynab, the perfume seller, al-Hawlaʾ:
When you sell, then act with excellence and do not deceive, for that is purer and more enduring for wealth.

key_terms.الْمَالِ: wealth or property gained through trade
key_terms.بِعْتِ: when you sell or conduct a sale
key_terms.تَغُشِّي: to cheat, deceive, or defraud in trade
key_terms.فَأَحْسِنِي: show excellence, goodness, and proper conduct in selling

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about honesty and deception in selling?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches honesty and excellence in trade. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instructs that deception should be avoided because integrity brings greater purity and lasting blessing to one's wealth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3985 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (may Allah (swt) bless him and his family) said to Zaynab, the perfume seller, known as Al-Hawla':
"When you sell, do so with excellence and do not deceive, for it is purer and more enduring for wealth."
